```{r}
round(3.14159)
round(3.14159, digits = 2)
```

```{r}
#order is from to by
print(seq(1,10,2))
print(seq(by = 2, from = 1, to = 10))
```
```{r}
#order is x, times
print(rep(2,5))
print(rep(5,7))
print(rep(times = 7, x = 5))
```

```{r}
x <- 1
y <- "hello"
z <- TRUE
print(x)
print(y)
print(z)
print(class(x))
print(class(y))
print(class(z))
```
